svg.title: At a fixed strictly ordered temporal height y, the strict restriction fv,y is bounded and continuous by (SW7). Its integral against a joint test therefore defines a tempered distribution uy. In (FT2) use the compact test e−⟨ey,q⟩g(q). Its exponential lift cancels exactly. The preceding cutoffremoval then gives c Wv(Deyg) = buy(g)
